t: ATAYAL | Facts and Details
s: In the old days the Atayal were the most notorious headhunters on Taiwan. Tribal wars were fought over territory and honor. Heads were used in ancestor worship rituals and the skull, teeth, and hair were used for protection against malevolent spirits. Society was organized along patrilineal lines in hamlet groups.
